entries.8be32e2d819b5101: As its management philosophy, the company states that it consistently provides professional-quality service at every stage of drug development and pursues the well-being of its stakeholders: pharmaceutical companies, medical institutions, patients, shareholders and employees. To achieve this, the company focuses on specific disease areas with high unmet medical needs and high development difficulty, such as cancer, the central nervous system and immune diseases. Under its medium-term management plan, with the fiscal year ended March 2028 as the final year, it aims to build a system for conducting international joint clinical trials across Asia including Japan, the United States and Europe, and to differentiate itself from domestic peers by expanding its overseas bases, with the goal of becoming a global CRO originating in Japan.
